cohort: 383 immediate postpartum mothers and 10 health service providers at Muhima Hospital, Rwanda
finding: PPIUCD uptake was associated with vaginal delivery, antenatal PPIUCD counselling, spousal approval, multiparity, short birth interval (<2 years), and level of education.
mod_finding: Women who had spontaneous vaginal delivery were more likely to take up PPIUCD compared to those who had cesarean section.
